content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PM SHRI KV EAC Upper Shillong Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Register online through the KVS Samvida Sathi (SAMAGAM) portal https://samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in/ or via https://eacuppershillong.kvs.ac.in/. Upload soft copy of certificates at the time of registration. Complete online registration by 9 November 2026. Report at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya, EAC Upper Shillong on 10 November 2026 from 8:30 am. Bring the filled registration form, 2 recent passport size photographs, original testimonials and a set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for PM SHRI KV EAC Upper Shillong Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in PM SHRI KV EAC Upper Shillong Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for PGT - Economics.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for PM SHRI KV EAC Upper Shillong Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per KVS norms.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per KVS latest eligibility rules. Desirable: knowledge of Computer Applications and proficiency to teach in English and Hindi.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Online registration on KVS Samvida Sathi portal is mandatory.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Unregistered candidates will not be allowed to appear for interview. Candidates will be debarred if documents are not produced or information is found wrong.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Personal Interview. Mode of interview: Personal Interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be asked to produce supporting documents on the day of interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely part time contractual engagement for academic session 2026-27. Can be terminated when the post is filled by a regular incumbent, service is not satisfactory or no more required, or without giving any reason. The post will not be regularized in any case.
